source.doc_type: CAR disclosure with reviewed consolidated and separate interim financial statements 2Q2026 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (6 months to 30 June 2026 = year to date). Phillip Life Assurance. Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers; printed folio + 13 = file page). CAR disclosure p.1-3, review report (Deloitte) from p.4. Units differ: the SCI (three months p.7, six months p.9) is in Baht, the notes in thousand Baht. The SCI has consolidated and separate columns; the separate columns are used (owner decision: separate statements). The separate statements account for the subsidiary by the equity method; its share of loss is included in other income (net), as in FY2025. The insurance notes are common to both. Note 5 (columns non-PAA 6.1 / PAA 6.2 / total; six months): revenue p.23, expenses p.24; incurred claims and acquisition amortisation include PAA (the PAA amortisation column prints +7,427 year to date, as printed). CSM roll-forward (note 6.1, reconciliation by measurement component, ณ วันที่ 30 มิถุนายน 2569) p.29-30; future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment (CSM column). New business p.32 (six months); totals used (the onerous column shows a CSM of 18,418, as before). RA release uses note 5, equal to the AOC RA. Insurance service result is a loss year to date (onerous losses 266,297). Other expense = finance costs + other operating expenses. The three-month profit or loss is the separate SCI for the three months to 30 June 2569 (p.7).
